data.exact_reserve_text: In addition to a low incidence of catastrophe losses, the year benefited from a significant favourable prior year reserve development within the Marine, Energy and long-tail inward reinsurance portfolios, together with better than expected attritional development on International Property binders.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 was GBP 1,861.785m. The report identifies favourable prior year reserve development in Marine, Energy and long-tail inward reinsurance portfolios and better-than-expected attritional development on International Property binders; however no gross prior-year re-estimation amount is presented. The available claims development triangle is reported on a net basis and indicates effectively no aggregate net prior-year movement, so overall the prior-year position is reported here as flat (net prior-year development ~GBP 0.0m).
raw_causal_phrases: significant favourable prior year reserve development within the Marine, Energy and long-tail inward reinsurance portfolios
better than expected attritional development on International Property binders

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure is presented in the notes. The only available claims development table is presented on a NET basis (note 15), so the prior year development here is derived from the net triangle as a fallback (net PYD = GBP 0.0m). The narrative describes favourable prior-year reserve development in specific portfolios but does not quantify gross amounts. All monetary source tables are presented in the accounts in GBP '000; opening reserves were converted to millions for this output.
